title: Launch | 2024 Unique Award Opens — Seeking AI Innovation Pioneers
summary: Since 2019, Unique Research’s Unique Award (非凡奖) has run five years as a digital-commerce innovation marker — spotting leaders and newcomers across marketing, creative, conversion, and experience. In 2024 the award upgrades into a professional honor for artificial-intelligence
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Event / Call for entries · June 18, 2024

Since 2019, Unique Research’s Unique Award (非凡奖) has run five years as a digital-commerce innovation marker — spotting leaders and newcomers across marketing, creative, conversion, and experience. In 2024 the award upgrades into a professional honor for artificial-intelligence breakthroughs: companies, technologies, and products. It recognizes past achievement and expected long-term potential. Domestic AI pioneers are invited to join.

Jury

Industry and tech leaders, enterprises, brands, investors, scholars, and a media alliance — multiple lenses for authority. Committees: Technology Experts; Enterprise Representatives; Brand Representatives; Investors; Academia; Media Alliance.

Method & scoring

Industry research + expert review. Desk research on product, tech, customers, and awareness, plus deep interviews with known customers; jury scores from research and domain experience.

  • Case influence 20% — search heat; WeChat / Weibo followers; mini-program search, etc.
  • Product innovation 30% — uniqueness and white-space demand filled
  • Tech foresight 25% — patents/IP; expert view on novelty and future headroom
  • Customer recognition 25% — renewal and satisfaction interviews

Timeline

  • Jun 18 – Nov 11, 2024 — online case submission
  • Nov 12 – Dec 11, 2024 — industry research & expert review
  • December 2024 — awards on stage at UniqueBloom (非凡大赏)

Prior-year award categories and submission channel: see CN images / ingest assets.

Rules (summary)

Unique Research may reclassify mis-filed categories; entrants must own/control submitted text/images/video and warrant originality; customer authorization assumed for review publicity; Unique Research may disqualify non-compliant entries. Submitted materials become Unique Research property and are non-returnable; participation grants a non-exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, transferable, royalty-free, paid-up license for secondary edits and social distribution.

4 CN images (jury / timeline / channel); attach on ingest. Signup URLs not expanded here.

— END —
